tests: Search Online passes the error's text into the search URL unencoded, so an & in it ends the query
steps:
1. Run a program that executes Err.Raise 5, , "Fails with A & B".
2. At the error panel, click Search Online.
3. The IDE runs cmd.exe /c start "link" "https://www.google.com/search?q=twinBASIC VB6 Run-time error 5 (00000005) Fails with A & B": the text is not URL-encoded, so the browser's query ends at the &, and searches for twinBASIC VB6 Run-time error 5 (00000005) Fails with A.
The lane records the command line in place of root.Shell and opens no browser.
